name: Aldyar Alarabiya
verdict: Saudi real-estate developer, part of Shahm Holding — the Al-Atawi family's Jeddah holding. Nothing found.
note: Al-Ettifaq front sponsor (2026-27). Longstanding Al-Taawoun main sponsor ('primary sponsor since 2023' per its own site), but it is gone from Al-Taawoun's 2026-27 home shirt in the club's own launch photography (issue #377). CMA approved a 10% Nomu listing in 2023 and a 30% Tasi listing, both not consummated (Asharq Business, shares delayed).
